name: Heartwood Regent
prompt: Create one stunning hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG boss master reference for Elyndra. Heartwood Regent: a towering figure of living wood grown round a brass pump-heart, a crown of branches, roots for legs, jade light pulsing through its veins with each pump stroke. Regal ancient living tree humanoid, tall powerful wooden torso, intricate visible BRASS PUMP HEART with cylinder chambers and piston mechanism nested in chest, branching jade veins through bark, majestic crown of living branches. Two long wooden arms with root fingers, two massive root legs. Distinct from a squat robot: slender towering tree king, organic growth swallowing machinery. Strict FRONT orthographic eye-level, entire body faces directly toward viewer, neutral symmetrical stance. Warm hand-painted RPG texture, readable strong silhouette, detailed wood grain and aged brass, restrained jade luminescence. Square transparent canvas, creature occupies 75 percent height, wide empty margins, all branch crown tips and roots entirely visible. No background haze, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no other characters. All glow contained in veins, no detached particles.
